_comment: Permission rules that shipped as add-on defaults in earlier versions and have since been replaced. The additive merge in init-user/run can never drop an entry on its own, so these are pruned from the persistent settings.json by exact string match on every start. The Bash entries used the undocumented `Bash(cmd *)` space-glob form, which does not match the way `Bash(cmd:*)` does. The Read/Edit/Write entries used a single leading slash, which in user settings anchors at ~/.claude rather than the filesystem root, so `Edit(/homeassistant/**)` matched /root/.claude/homeassistant; they are replaced by `//` absolute forms. Write rules are dropped outright: Claude Code only matches Edit rules for file permission checks, and Edit covers all file-editing tools.
